params.title: Why goals die in the middle

caption.instagram:
Why I can't stay consistent after a good day: the licensing trap.

Why we stop doing things we know are good for us, reason #26: the good day. Neha codes three hours on Monday, her best day in weeks. Tuesday: I've earned a night off. Wednesday she's tired. By Thursday it's next week. Psychologists call it licensing: progress feels like permission to stop.

The fix:
- Don't stop to reward a good day
- Before you close the laptop, write tomorrow's first step
- Keep it 10 minutes

What did you skip after a good day? Tell me below.
